what: The encoder endpoint before and after the restart for the review of 70dbefe: the proxy relays only this account's connections (the client socket's owner from sock_diag), its refusal logs are throttled, it keeps its socket's backlog, and its unit runs it in a systemd sandbox. Both records were written by scripts/endpoint_checks.py --foreign (1,000 idle connections of this account; one unauthenticated GET /health each from uid 0 and uid 65534 in throwaway containers of the lock's image on the host network, and from this account); 'before_restart' also carries the doctor's new 'serving units' check run alone (health._units_check) on the old wiring.

restarts.what: systemctl --user reset-failed (the six mesa-clm units), then systemctl --user restart mesa-clm-encoder.service mesa-clm-serve.service
restarts.result: the encoder served on its socket at 21:57:24Z, but the proxy under the first sandbox (with the mount-namespace options, which imply PrivateUsers= in a user manager) could not connect to it: Ubuntu's AppArmor confined the proxy as 'unprivileged_userns' and denied each connect() ('Failed name lookup - disconnected path', name run/mesa-clm/encoder.sock, error -13; 284 kernel audit lines until 22:07:04Z), so :8090 closed every connection ('cannot reach ...: Permission denied', 69 throttled proxy lines); clm-serve's wait for :8090/health timed out at 22:05:25Z and systemd restarted it once

restarts.what: the namespace options removed from the proxy unit (deploy/systemd/), install -m 0644 + daemon-reload, then systemctl --user restart mesa-clm-encoder-proxy.service (the proxy only; the encoder was not restarted again)
restarts.result: clm-serve's wait answered 200 and clm-serve came up at 22:07:04Z

notes: before: the proxy of 70dbefe relays any account's connection (uid 0 and uid 65534 each got the encoder's 92-byte '200 OK' to an unauthenticated /health) and runs unsandboxed (NoNewPrivs 0, Seccomp 0; systemd-analyze --user security 9.8 UNSAFE); the doctor's new 'serving units' check fails it (unit file not the rendering, proxy not sandboxed)

after: uid 0 and uid 65534 get nothing back (closed at once, one throttled journal line for both), this account's same request gets '200 OK'; the proxy runs with NoNewPrivs 1 and seccomp mode 2 (5.9 MEDIUM): no namespace, see the restarts; 1,000 idle connections of this account take 2,009 descriptors and a keyed GET /v1/models is answered while they are held; lock problems none; units not enabled

the proxy process recorded after the restart runs the copy installed at 21:54Z (sha256 a75df3ba...), which differs from the committed serving/encoder_proxy.py (installed at 22:07Z, 4168caa5...) only in comments and the wording of the other-account log line ('uid 0 here;' for 'uid 0;'); the committed copy takes effect at the next start of the units
encoder_fp c3b3d5e1a283 and lock_sha dd33f9fe... unchanged (units and the proxy are not in the lock); the doctor's record of the restarted units is doctor_serve_m1e.json
